dog.description_text:
Meet sweet Nestle! This young girl was found all alone in a park, so unfortunately, we don't know much about her history or past behavior. Since coming into our care, though, Nestle has been nothing but friendly and affectionate.

Nestle is a playful, energetic girl who loves being around people and is always ready for some fun. She has a happy spirit and plenty of puppy-like energy to share. With her sweet personality and playful nature, Nestle is sure to bring lots of love and laughter to her forever home.

Come meet this adorable girl and give sweet Nestle the loving home she deserves!
dog.name: Nestle
